title: Get the app to get your greens
slide_intent: Combine a direct action with a familiar benefit so a physical sign can lead people into a digital service.
strategic_value: The greens phrase and illustrated bowl can make Sweetgreen’s app invitation feel connected to the food offer.
demonstration: A pale sidewalk sign in a white metal frame carries a large app headline, compact numbered copy and a colorful illustrated bowl with the wordmark near the bottom.
practical_value: Balance a readable action headline with supporting instructions and brand illustration on a street-facing sign.

content_islands.name: Action headline
content_islands.spec: Place the large green app invitation near the top of the sign.

content_islands.name: Supporting content
content_islands.spec: Keep the smaller numbered copy below it and the illustrated bowl toward the lower right.

content_islands.name: Physical placement
content_islands.spec: Retain the white frame, pavement and surrounding architecture.

reference_purposes.Application: The sign connects a physical restaurant environment to app use.
reference_purposes.Expression: Large green type and colorful food illustration share a pale panel.
